hints.title: Carry the maximum
hints.body: When you move from a parent to a child, the only information needed from the path above is the largest value seen so far.

hints.title: Decide at the node
hints.body: A node is unobstructed exactly when its value is at least the maximum value on the path before it, including its parent.

hints.title: Update the maximum
hints.body: Pass the larger of the current maximum and the node's value to both children. Count the node before descending.

hints.title: Pseudocode
hints.body:
```
count = 0
function walk(node, maximum):
    if node is null: return
    if node.value >= maximum: count = count + 1
    nextMaximum = max(maximum, node.value)
    walk(node.left, nextMaximum)
    walk(node.right, nextMaximum)
walk(root, value of root)
return count
```

This is pseudocode, not a complete solution.
